metadata.title: Public Key Infrastructure

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for establishing and governing certificate-based cryptographic trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Certificate authorities, trust anchors, certificate issuance, validation, and revocation mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for institutional governance of certificate-based trust relationships.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Public key infrastructure relies on secure cryptographic key lifecycle management.

metadata.remarks: Public Key Infrastructure defines trust properties required to establish, validate, and revoke certificate-based cryptographic trust. This pattern governs trust anchors and certificate lifecycles and does not define application authentication flows or encryption policy.

components.title: Certificate Authorities and Trust Anchors
components.description: Defines trusted root and intermediate certificate authorities used by the institution.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or misuse of certificate authority trust anchors.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strict governance and protection of CA root trust.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Trusted certificate authorities and trust anchors are defined and protected.

components.title: Certificate Issuance
components.description: Governs certificate enrollment, identity proofing, and issuance processes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Issuance of certificates to unauthorized entities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Certificate issuance is bound to verified identity attributes.

components.title: Certificate Validation
components.description: Ensures certificate chains and trust paths are validated prior to use.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of expired, invalid, or untrusted certificates.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Automated validation of certificate trust chains.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Certificate validity and trust are verified prior to acceptance.

components.title: Certificate Revocation
components.description: Revokes and invalidates certificates that are expired, compromised, or no longer authorized.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Continued use of revoked or compromised certificates.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Timely revocation and dissemination of certificate status.

components.title: Cross-Domain and Federated Trust
components.description: Supports certificate trust across organizational or domain boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of federated trust relationships to gain unauthorized access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit governance of cross-domain certificate trust.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cross-domain trust relationships are authorized and governed.
